rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Extreme-Fear tape: total crypto market cap -2.1% to ~$2.21T amid a broad risk-off session. BTC is the day's firmest major at ~-1.67% vs ETH -2.3% and SOL -5.2%. Structural support: US spot BTC ETFs snapped a 10-day outflow streak with a +$221.7M haul (largest in 2 months), and the SEC's 'Regulation Crypto' agenda is slated for release this July — a clarifying, demand-supportive catalyst.
positions.driver: Low-edge, fearful day — rulebook favors the liquid major with the most downside protection over the highest-beta name. BTC has the deepest liquidity, lowest beta, clearest relative strength today, and the tightest 8% stop band. Runners-up rejected: SOL ($77.53, -5.2%) is the highest-beta and worst performer; ETH ($1,742.98, -2.3%) carries net ETF outflows; XRP ($1.0921) has the best standalone catalyst (8th straight week of ETF inflows, ~$1.47B cumulative) but is a higher-beta alt into rising BTC dominance (~55%) and a falling-knife tape — the same setup that cost the book last week. Entry = dashboard live feed (asOf 2026-07-09T11:54:38Z).
positions.risks: Extreme Fear can accelerate to the downside — a break of support could trip the 8% stop at $57,657.70. Two-sided macro/regulatory headline risk on a 24/7 tape; conflicting ETF-flow reports (one source shows BTC ETFs still in a multi-week outflow streak with capital rotating to XRP/SOL) mean structural demand is not clean. Even majors can gap on weekend headlines.
